trigger: tick 1
text: Designate a place to dig with [d]. Dwarves dig into rock faces from the side.

trigger: no still exists and drink < 40 units
text: Dwarves need drink. Build a still [b › Workshops] and brew from plants.

trigger: no stockpile exists and items on the ground > 20
text: Set up a stockpile [z] so hauled goods have somewhere to go.

trigger: day 20 of spring, year 1
text: Winter comes in 60 days. Farms need soil or mud; cave crops grow in the dark all year.

trigger: no hearth and at least one dining hall or 5 bedrooms
text: A hearth makes a hall a home. Build one [b › Special] in your main hall.

trigger: a drink or seed stockpile exists without barrels or bags
text: Stockpiles need barrels for drink and bags for seeds. The carpenter makes barrels; the clothier makes bags.

trigger: a workshop is blocked because no barrel is empty
text: A brew needs an empty barrel, and a barrel that holds food or seed is not empty. Order a barrel at the carpenter's workshop.

trigger: a smelter or forge is blocked for fuel
text: Smelters and forges need fuel. A wood furnace makes charcoal from logs; coal seams burn too.

trigger: hunting labor enabled and no crossbow or bow exists
text: Hunters need a crossbow and bolts, or a bow and arrows.

trigger: a farm plot placement is refused
text: Farms need soil, mud left by water, or cave loam.

trigger: first harvest
text: Harvest returns one seed. Brewing and cooking do not.

trigger: a bedroom zone with tier bare exists for 3 days
text: A room needs walls or doors around it, a bed, and smooth stone to be worth sleeping in.

trigger: first ThreatWarning
text: Click a door and choose Lock on alert. Then [m] and [3] raise the Hearth alert: civilians go to the hearth and those doors lock, but a dwarf in dire need still goes out to eat, drink or sleep, and the medics still tend the wounded.

trigger: day 14 of summer, year 1, no depot
text: Build a trade depot [b › Special] before the caravan arrives.

trigger: first serious wound with no hospital
text: A hospital zone needs a bed, a chest, cloth and thread. Brightleaf treats infection.

trigger: first ImmigrationSkipped
text: Immigrants come at the turn of the season when hall spirit is Content. Good rooms, meals and drink raise it.

trigger: first raid ended
text: A drawbridge over a channel is the surest gate. Build a lever inside [b], click it, press [i] and click the bridge; [y] pulls it.

trigger: first cage trap built
text: Cage traps catch anything smaller than a wyrm. Caged beasts can be tamed at a kennel or sold.

trigger: first DoorBroken
text: Trollkin break doors. Walls and raised bridges hold.

trigger: first VeinFound deepsilver
text: Deepsilver lies beside the Sea of Fire. Taking it wakes the Hollow. The threats panel shows the Deep gauge.

trigger: first cavern 2 breach
text: A forge over channeled magma needs no fuel. Build it of magma-safe stone.

trigger: DayPassed: more than IDLE_HAULER_WARNING items want hauling and fewer than HAULER_WARNING_MIN_WORKERS dwarves have hauling enabled
text: Items are waiting to be hauled. Enable hauling for more dwarves in the labors panel.
